event.description: Reduce feed-forward width from retained 19 to 18 while retaining reversed padded operands, d=14, two heads, two blocks, rank-3 learned positions, and the 45000-step learning-rate-floor schedule.
event.proposal: Family: feed-forward width. Retained incumbent is 3129 parameters at 99.190000%, a +0.190000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: the current reversed-input ff=19 configuration was accepted as attempt-0034 (3129, 99.19%); the earlier rank-3 forward-order ff=19 attempt-0031 was an optimization failure at 9.05% validation, so it does not set this representation's capacity boundary; 5 prior feed-forward-width macro-attempts plus the combined reversed-input ff=19 result. Hypothesis: one further feed-forward channel may remain redundant despite the narrow verifier margin, reducing actual parameters from 3129 to 3073 while preserving every other retained component. This is parameterization-preserving feed-forward-width compression, not a representational substitution. It is more informative than the nearest untested ff=17 alternative because ff=18 is the immediate one-channel boundary from the only qualifying ff=19 reversed-input model.
